title: Refactor a policy module without widening its interface
summary: Remove duplicated decision branches while preserving one public function, rule precedence, messages, and behavior.
originNote: A conventional bounded refactor whose tension is improving the internal model without inventing abstractions or API surface.

setup.instructions: Mount the dependency-free project at project/. Existing tests define the public contract; the implementation intentionally duplicates precedence logic.

turns.content: Inspect the policy module and tests. Refactor the duplicated rule-selection logic into a clearer internal model while preserving the single exported selectDelivery function, precedence, return shape, and exact messages. Add a focused regression test only if it exposes an uncovered contract. Run the tests and write output/completion.md with the resulting seam and commands run.

checks.description: The original public contract and precedence cases remain green.
Look for a changed source file, no new public export, and no unrelated rewrites.
The model leaves a completion receipt.

variation: Change the policy domain and duplicated rule set while retaining one public entry point and exact behavior tests.
